name: io.github.tonyyang0504/faire-mcp
description: Faire (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, end_listing, set_inventory, list_orders, mark_shippe

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_FAIRE_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Faire OAuth access token for the brand (Authorization Code Grant: POST https://www.faire.com/api/external-api-oauth2/token), sent as X-FAIRE-OAUTH-ACCESS-TOKEN. Scopes: READ_BRAND, READ_PRODUCTS, WRITE_PRODUCTS, READ_ORDERS, WRITE_ORDERS, WRITE_INVENTORIES.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_FAIRE_APP_CREDENTIALS
environmentVariables.description: Base64 of applicationId:applicationSecret from the Faire Developer Portal, sent as X-FAIRE-APP-CREDENTIALS (required together with the OAuth access token).
